d.tr: So I will ping you on WhatsApp
d.ctx: The user and expert are discussing meeting up and the user suggests moving the conversation to WhatsApp. The expert agrees.
d.j: The user proposes moving the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp).

d.seg: ನಂಬರು ಡಬಲ್ ಏಯ್ಟ್... ಫೈವ್ ಏಯ್ಟ್ ನೈನ್
d.ctx: The user is dictating their phone number to the expert so they can connect outside the app. The expert is listening and confirming.
d.j: The user is providing their phone number to move the contact outside the app.
